picks.why: Cabin: clean chunky logs and a single simple roof, with no stepping stones (1) or odd blocks under the log ends (3).
Iron Gate: slender, believable ironwork reads instantly as a gate; 2 and 3 add heavy door-style handles and knockers.
Candle: smooth soft wax and clean drips with a modest dish; 1 has a pitted surface and reads more like a pudding.
Full Moon: soft maria patches read as moon; 1 has only craters on flat yellow and reads as cheese.
Spider: clear eight legs, correct body proportions and a restrained marking; 1 has a muddled leg count and 2's dots form a flower pattern.
Rocking Horse: solid simple body and neck with no invented girth strap (1) or spindly neck and seamed torso (3).
Armchair: three-quarter view gives real depth and natural proportions, like the real card; 1 is stubby and frontal, 3 has an overly tall back.
Mirror: balanced oval with restrained ornament and a stable stand; 1 has excess scrollwork and 3 is narrow with a shifted stone colour.
Lantern: near-upright, simple, true proportions; 1 has an oversized ring and warped base, 2 has an exaggerated tilt.
Candy Corn: plain three-band candy with no extras; 2 and 3 invent purple marks on the tip.
